Messages.Author: Henrik
Messages.Body:
If I gave played a minor boon on my grandpredators vampire, can my predator
deflect/redirect/misdircet the bleed from that vampire to me, and what
happens in that case?

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
I would think that your predator would not be able to deflect it to you,
that minion is not allowed to bleed you, wether via a deflection or by
taking a bleed action.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Henrik" <henri...@spray.se> wrote in message
news:9r0rm5$qv6n1$1...@ID-99227.news.dfncis.de...

> If I gave played a minor boon on my grandpredators vampire, can my predator

> deflect/redirect/misdircet the bleed from that vampire to me, and what
> happens in that case?

The bleed cannot be bounced to you.
You are not a valid target for the bleed.
If there are only the three of you in the game,
then that vampire's bleed cannot be bounced.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra
